formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) (x3 : Finset (Fin x1)) (x4 : (Fin x1 → Bool) → Bool), x2.Colorable (2 : ℕ) → (∀ x6 ∉ x3, (x2.neighborSet x6).ncard = (3 : ℕ)) → (∀ (x7 : Fin x1) (x8 : x2.Walk x7 x7), x8.IsCycle → (7 : ℕ) ≤ x8.length) → (∀ (x8 x9 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x8 x9 → x8 ∉ x3) → (∃ (x9 : Fin x1) (x10 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x9 x10) → (∀ (x10 : Fin x1 → Bool), x4 x10 = Bool.true ↔ (∃ x11 ∈ x3, x10 x11 = Bool.true) ∨ ∃ (x11 : Fin x1) (x12 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x11 x12 ∧ x10 x11 = Bool.true ∧ x10 x12 = Bool.true) → ∀ (x11 : ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize x1 x4 x11 → ∃ (x13 : Fin x1) (x14 : Fin x1), x13 ∉ x3 ∧ x14 ∉ x3 ∧ x13 ≠ x14 ∧ ¬x2.Adj x13 x14 ∧ ∃ (x15 : ℕ), x15 + (8 : ℕ) ≤ x11 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize x1 (fun (x16 : Fin x1 → Bool) => x4 (Function.update (Function.update x16 x13 Bool.false) x14 Bool.false)) x15
plain_statement: If G is bipartite, G has at least one edge, every cycle of length at least 7, A a set of vertices met by no edge, every vertex outside A with exactly 3 neighbours, and f true exactly when a variable of A is true or both ends of an edge are true, then for every s with an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit of s gates computing f, there are two distinct non-adjacent vertices u, v outside A such that f with x_u and x_v fixed false has such a circuit of at most s - 8 gates.
title: A step toward: Cubic piece, cycles at least 7, edge function plus OR-variables: a vertex whose deletion lowers fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT size by at least 4
